paper_metadata.title: Ductile heat-resistant Mg-Gd-Y alloys of high strength via lamellated heterostructure

evidence.quote: In this study, we focus on Mg-RE alloys to demonstrate a strategy for simultaneously achieving excellent high-temperature strength and decent RT ductility.

evidence.quote: Before undergoing multi-pass hot rolling, these plates were pre-heated to 200 ◦C for 30 min in a resistance furnace, with the mill rolls heated to the same temperature. The rolling involved multiple passes, reducing plate thickness by 2 %–5 % each time, accompanied by a 90◦ in-plane rotation after each pass, resulting in 4 mm thick sheets.

The 4 mm thick sheets were then subjected to a double-ageing treatment, achieving peak-aged conditions at 100 ◦C for 8 h and 200 ◦C for 36 h. The final peak-aged samples are referred to as MR + A samples.
